title: object.titleFormat has no effect when the object authors no nameField: the registry stamps a derived nameField that outranks the template, so the record title ignores it
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Ruled: 6574393684 · letter B · 2026-11-02T10:06Z

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix acceptance[1]).
Business reason: an author (or AI agent) who writes `titleFormat: '{code} @ {city}'` on an object gets a save and a publish that both succeed, then a record page and list that show only `code`. The key is deprecated (ADR-0079) but still accepted, so today it is a silent no-op: either it should apply when no nameField is authored, or it should be refused at save with its prescription.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the `domain:spec` lane (decide honour vs refuse per ADR-0079 / ADR-0049), with the ui half in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` if it is honoured. QA suggestion only: p3.
Duplicate search: `titleFormat` → 71 hits (closed included). The near ones are closed and different: #24087 (search palette rendered titleFormat before nameField), #25129 / #25071 (docs and lint steering composite titles), #20059 (system objects declaring titleFormat and no pointer). `titleFormat inert nameField stamped` → 5 hits, none about this.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. As admin, on a writable package: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qar8_tf2?mode=draft&package=PKG` with `{name:'qar8_tf2', sharingModel:'public_read_write', titleFormat:'{code} @ {city}', fields:{code:{type:'text'}, city:{type:'text'}}}` (no nameField), then `POST /api/v1/packages/PKG/publish-drafts` → published.
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/qar8_tf2` → `titleFormat` "{code} @ {city}" and a stamped `nameField: "code"` (the stored draft has none).
3. `POST /api/v1/data/qar8_tf2 {code:'ZX-42', city:'Lyon'}`; open the record page and the list in the console.

Expected: the H1 and the list primary read "ZX-42 @ Lyon" (or the save refuses titleFormat). Actual: "ZX-42". The same with `'{name} · {code}'` on another object → only the name. Reproduced 3 times, fresh browser and sign-in each.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`packages/spec/src/data/display-name.ts` `provisionPrimary` stamps a derived nameField at registration, so "no nameField was authored" is lost; `containers.tsx` (about L2795–2830) ranks nameField / displayNameField above titleFormat, and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-record-reads.ts` says "a stamped pointer outranks the template too". The spec describe says only that "an explicit nameField now takes precedence".

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix · acceptance[1]
